scripts.build: rm -f wrangler.jsonc && astro build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/server/wrangler.json','utf8'));c.main='./dist/server/entry.mjs';if(c.assets&&c.assets.directory){c.assets.directory='./dist/client';}c.name='aktu-result';c.topLevelName='aktu-result';c.compatibility_flags=Array.from(new Set([...(c.compatibility_flags||[]),'nodejs_compat']));fs.writeFileSync('wrangler.jsonc', JSON.stringify(c,null,2));"
